text:
Type: slipcovered sofa with chaise
Use: lounging, seating for family and guests; living room, family room
Style: coastal, traditional, farmhouse
Materials: cotton-blend slipcover fabric, skirted hem
Colors: dark navy blue
Shape: L-shaped sectional with right-side chaise, rolled arms, three loose back cushions, two seat cushions, box-pleat skirt hiding legs, large and soft
Feel: relaxed, cozy, casual
Goes with: white walls, light wood, striped textiles, natural fibers; coastal or farmhouse living rooms

product.name: Stone & Beam Carrigan Casual Sofa Chaise, 95"W, Navy
product.description: Overall: 95"W x 39"D x 37"H; seat height: 22.5"H; seat depth: 28"D; seat back height: 32.5"H; arm height: 27"H; leg height: 3"H; chaise depth: 70.5"D; chaise width: 34.5"W Removable slipcover in 100% cotton fabric; fully padded solid-wood frame with mortise-and-tenon construction and 8-gauge sinuous spring support system Slipcover is removable for easy cleaning and refreshing. Loose back and seat cushions are removable and reversible to ensure durability and comfort. Assemble in 15-30 minutes Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. This item is made to order just for you.
